300.author: wyhohyw
300.body:
﻿Daily CI gave RACE and FACT one shared 10-minute deadline. RACE finished, then the judge was killed while citation checking was still running, so citation accuracy and verification coverage were never recorded. On the 13 and 14 October nightlies every DRB case showed this. Forty minutes covers those runs except a DRB-64 report that cites the same manuals as dozens of distinct statements; thirty minutes still clips that report and leaves only about three minutes of margin on the next-slowest cases.

## Evaluation deadline
`.github/workflows/real-e2e.yml` sets `E2E_DRB_EVAL_TIMEOUT_MS` to `2400000`. The local default stays one hour. The DeepResearchBench README's daily evaluation budget matches this deadline. Research shard jobs remain capped at 240 minutes, so the longer judge fits inside the job.

## Validation
`pnpm ci:ut`, `pnpm ci:st`, and `pnpm ci:e2e` were not run. This commit changes a nightly workflow constant and its README; those layers do not execute the real DRB judge. WSL on this machine has bubblewrap, but the fresh worktree has no `node_modules`, and installing it would not observe the 40-minute deadline. The check is the next nightly after this merges and syncs to GitHub: each DRB case should record citation accuracy and verification coverage instead of `running`.

## E2E user journeys
Not applicable. No UI, API, CLI, or session behavior changes. Delivery assertions are unchanged; only the separate judge deadline in daily CI is longer.
